slides.text: A goal is an *outcome*. You don't control outcomes.
An input is an *action* you can repeat.
Add a *minimum version* for bad days. *5 minutes counts.*
Review *weekly*. Ask what got in the way. *Remove one thing.*
Outcomes are the *scoreboard*. Inputs are the *game*.
Turn one goal into an input today.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily
